long_biography.plain_text:
Robin Jones began helping at his family's Wrexham bakery as a teenager, putting lids on mince pies. His father Alan and grandfather had acquired the business, and Jones later became its managing director. He and his brother Christien expanded production of bread, pastries and gluten-free products. Their bakeries supplied supermarkets and food-service customers far beyond Wrexham.

After a destructive factory fire, the family pressed ahead with a new production site. Jones remained at the helm when Limerston Capital took a controlling investment and was still chief executive and co-owner at the sale to Groupe Menissez. He has since left the managing-director role and has been recognised for his contribution to Welsh food manufacturing.
